sample_unit: adult patients receiving invasive mechanical ventilation >48 h
models_evaluated: MM-HNN (3D ResNet-50 + LSTM + LASSO clinical predictors)

links.outcome: Model AUC compared against clinical pulmonary infection score (CPIS) for VAP prediction
links.quote: The model achieved an area under the curve of 0.86 (95% confidence interval: 0.80-0.91), outperforming the clinical pulmonary infection score (p = 0.021).

unlisted_practices: SHAP-based interpretability analysis of a multimodal VAP prediction model

screen.reason: The study develops and retrospectively evaluates a multimodal neural network combining CT imaging, ventilator parameters, and clinical data to predict ventilator-associated pneumonia and estimate clinical impact.
